authority: v0.95 Architecture Management R1 + R10 actual audit + issue ledger, not older v0.93 workflow

architecture.storage: GitHub fenced state + immutable Google Drive raw and parquet; no database pretending Drive folder listing is atomic

issues.problem: 16 source slots vs 14 tier QA lanes
issues.root_cause: Two distinct task axes were treated as simultaneous schedules
issues.remediation: One control ledger; ingestion slots have type INGEST/REPAIR/DAILY and layer lanes have type QA/TRANSFORM; no 30 always-on runners
issues.acceptance: Every task has one stable ID, task_type, source, dataset, asof_month and stage; duplicate dispatch returns SKIP

issues.root_cause: Filesystem existence check cannot fence competing cloud writers
issues.remediation: One committer with fenced lease/token and compare-and-swap state; immutable objects written under content hash
issues.acceptance: 2 competing runners yield exactly 1 committed pointer; stale lease and crash/retry do not overwrite

issues.root_cause: Existing candidate files in staging and other folders are counted missing in canonical source-month check
issues.remediation: Reconcile Drive id, canonical path, stage, dataset, native hash, version and validation scope; never infer from path only
issues.acceptance: Sep-Oct-Nov 18 source-month cells resolved into dataset/date proofs or UNKNOWN, no duplicate re-download

issues.root_cause: 11/18 source-months with files is not dataset or row completeness
issues.remediation: Per dataset/observation date/security historical universe, available_at and official earliest date; explicit UNKNOWN/NOT_DUE/N_A
issues.acceptance: No percent returned for UNKNOWN denominator; early TDCC/TPEx versions not false failures

issues.root_cause: Financial and macro values could leak revised/future information into backtests
issues.remediation: Record first_published_at, available_at, revised_at and decision_asof by official original document; fail-closed asof join
issues.acceptance: Synthetic time-travel tests reject future records and prefer correct revision vintage

issues.problem: No verified complete bulk adapters in active controller
issues.root_cause: R6/R7 produce zero new downloads; R10 is read-only candidate QA
issues.remediation: Promote one dataset-specific v0.95 adapter at a time to READY only after source schema and native checksum tests
issues.acceptance: One real missing source-date downloaded, readback SHA and idempotent restart produce one committed raw object

issues.problem: 443 catalog IDs vs exact formula DAG
issues.root_cause: Catalog membership was interpreted as computed indicators
issues.remediation: Formula hash, source field mapping, lookback, warmup, security asof and disabled reason per indicator
issues.acceptance: Only individually certified indicators materialized; rest DISABLED_WITH_REASON

issues.problem: Candidate SHA lineage vs full graph
issues.root_cause: A limited 2330/MA5 or catalog mapping does not certify all Gold rows
issues.remediation: Bronze→Silver→Gold immutable SHA parent list, formula digest and forward invalidation edges
issues.acceptance: 100% of released outputs trace to pinned parent SHA and forward-diff set is deterministic

issues.root_cause: R6/R7 and legacy reports recheck accepted candidate or use independent status
issues.remediation: One issue ledger with open/claimed/fixed/quarantined/closed; rerun failed affected partitions only
issues.acceptance: Same unchanged prior successful receipt = no Drive read/re-download; changed upstream invalidates affected output

issues.root_cause: Current timestamp in Silver output produced immutable filename collisions; per-day security partitions would multiply files
issues.remediation: Partition by dataset/market/year-month where appropriate; sort keys, stable metadata, content hash and compact only after QA
issues.acceptance: Same input+code version yields same SHA; different code version gets separate immutable output

issues.problem: Source semantics confused with download errors
issues.root_cause: TPEx --- and TDCC denominator/revision raised false raw corruption alarms
issues.remediation: Transport/schema/value/PIT/applicability/semantic warnings separated; keep raw bytes, no forced zero, status confirmed against official docs
issues.acceptance: 412 TPEx rows preserved, 496 TDCC flagged groups kept for group-level resolution; unproven remains HOLD

issues.problem: Missing operational SLO/cost and recovery proof
issues.root_cause: Run success but not effective throughput/cost/recoverability
issues.remediation: Track official requests, tasks ready/done, distinct downloaded bytes, retry %, Drive quota/size and restore manifest
issues.acceptance: One report with true denominators; restore immutable fixture and verify SHA after rollback

trial_plan.title: No-network contract and regression suite
trial_plan.goal: Validate 12 controls, 16 vs 14 taxonomy, output policy, PIT date logic and unknown completeness; no Drive writes
trial_plan.pass: all static and fault-injection tests green

trial_plan.title: 2026-09–11 manifest inventory only
trial_plan.goal: Cross-index known-good SHA in staging/canonical folder; find true missing as-of published dates
trial_plan.pass: No previously accepted source bytes redownloaded; each claimed missing item links official expected release evidence

trial_plan.title: One exact missing Bronze native data unit
trial_plan.goal: v0.95 adapter live HTTP → immutable Drive → SHA readback → Git CAS checkpoint; simulate duplicate and crash
trial_plan.pass: one committed identity, 100% hash readback; second attempt REUSED; stale runner cannot publish

trial_plan.title: One Silver + one Gold lineage pilot
trial_plan.goal: Transform verified parent; use a genuinely PIT-certifiable indicator, verify reverse and forward lineage
trial_plan.pass: code+formula digest, source SHA and asof assertions; noncertified indicator disabled

trial_plan.title: 6-work-unit bounded historical Bronze canary
trial_plan.goal: Two sources, known eligible dates, use known good skips, write only provable gaps; no automatic 27-year advance
trial_plan.pass: all tasks accounted, rollback/restore, zero duplicate accepted objects, explicit failed units
